pages.title: Secret Hall: Hidden Objects
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description: Open books that lead to different scenes in Secret Hall: Hidden Objects. Search rooms, markets, temples and city streets for the items requested. Swipe across the locations to inspect the details and complete each book's collection.

pages.title: Brass Labyrinth
pages.creator: NAbber Games
pages.description: Slide a marble through three hundred tabletop mazes in Brass Labyrinth. A flick sends it all the way to a wall, so plan the stopping point before moving. Collect every gem, avoid pits and pass one-way gates to unlock the exit.

pages.title: Cyber Rolling Going Ball 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Guide a ball along futuristic tracks in Cyber Rolling Going Ball 3D. Keep it centered through turns and time movements around the obstacles ahead. Reach the next safe section without losing the ball over an edge.

pages.title: Forest Match 4
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Make matches of fruit and gems in Forest Match 4. Follow a fairy guide through the village and forest, opening coin chests and completing the goals on each board. Work through the large collection of puzzle levels as the route expands.

pages.title: Gear Wars
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Build a troop-producing factory in Gear Wars. Combine gears with soldiers to increase the rate at which units such as Brutes and Archers appear. Manage the budget and assemble a production line strong enough to defeat the enemy force.

pages.title: Celebrities Get Ready For Christmas
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Prepare stars for a holiday gathering in Celebrities Get Ready For Christmas. Choose festive clothing and style the characters for the occasion. Coordinate the outfit details with the seasonal decorations as everyone gets ready.

pages.title: The Sorting Mart
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Rearrange goods into matching triples in The Sorting Mart. Clearing a shelf drops the stock above it, while removing a whole stack shifts neighboring shelves. Use those changes to reach the remaining items before the countdown ends.

pages.title: Hidden Horrors
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Search thirty spooky scenes in Hidden Horrors. Find six listed objects in each image before time runs out, checking the small Halloween decorations around larger shapes. Use a hint when the last item is hard to see.

pages.title: Ultimate Yatzy
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Roll five dice for scoring combinations in Ultimate Yatzy. Keep useful results and decide which dice to roll again while pursuing sets such as a full house or straight. Plan the score choices as you compete with opponents.

pages.title: Ragdoll Mania
pages.creator: Geniteam
pages.description: Aim and throw punches in Ragdoll Mania. Use the left mouse button to strike the floppy targets and see how they react through the physics-based minigames. Try the different activities as you work through the collection.

pages.title: Just Ludo
pages.creator: Drift Sand
pages.description: Move tokens around a board in Just Ludo. Choose a mode, roll the die and decide which piece can make the best use of the result. Bring your tokens to the finish before the opposing players complete theirs.

pages.title: Red Escape
pages.creator: isotronic
pages.description: Inspect a series of locked rooms in Red Escape. Collect useful items and match them with clues found in the surroundings. Solve each room's riddles to open the way into the next part of the escape.

pages.title: Space Pin Master - Pull Pin Puzzle
pages.creator: Ropoto
pages.description: Pull barriers to fill a waiting craft in Space Pin Master - Pull Pin Puzzle. Release balls in an order that keeps them away from bombs and obstacles. Earn coins to unlock more ball, pin, spaceship and theme designs.

pages.title: Foot Hospital
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Treat cartoon patients in Foot Hospital. Use the medical tools requested on screen to handle each foot problem. Work through the simulated cleaning and care steps before the next patient arrives.

pages.title: UFO Attack
pages.creator: AvidGame
pages.description: Abduct people and animals from a flying saucer in UFO Attack. Tap to activate the beam when a target is in position below you. Collect as many as possible before the opposition brings the craft down.

pages.title: Motorcycle simulator offline
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Explore stunt areas on sports bikes in Motorcycle simulator offline. Build speed for ramps and keep the motorcycle aligned when landing. Practice different approaches as you ride around the city and its elevated jumping routes.

pages.title: Hungry Snake Io
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Guide a growing worm without crashing in Hungry Snake Io. Try Endless, Toilet Man or Monster Brawl mode and keep away from rival bodies. Find a clear route through the arena as your own snake takes up more space.

pages.title: Merge cubes 2048 3D
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Combine equal numbered blocks in Merge cubes 2048 3D. The cubes bounce and collide, so account for how a shot may shift pieces already on the field. Keep creating larger values while leaving room for another merge.

pages.title: Block Puzzle - Jewel Forest
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Place gem shapes onto a grid in Block Puzzle - Jewel Forest. Fill a row or column to clear it and score, then look for the next useful opening. Keep the board flexible enough for the remaining blocks.

pages.title: Sword Life
pages.creator: Dorfer Games OU
pages.description: Find materials and forge blades in Sword Life. Use taps or the mouse to work each sword into shape, then sell the result. Continue gathering better resources so the next piece can improve the blacksmith's business.

pages.title: Would you Rather?
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: Compare hypothetical choices with friends in Would you Rather? Read a prompt, choose between its two options and see how the group's answers differ. Work through more than one hundred twenty questions for a shared conversation game.

pages.title: Drop It
pages.creator: AdelikDev
pages.description: Save fragile objects from breaking in Drop It. Guide the stick figure to catch items before they hit the ground. Read their movement and choose how to reach the next valuable piece in time.

pages.title: Cube Sorting
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Group cubes by color in Cube Sorting. Select the color you want to collect and pick matching cubes to organize them. Work through the sorting tasks by keeping each color together as the arrangements become more demanding.

pages.title: Running Bros
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Run through a long obstacle course in Running Bros. Collect coins and power-ups while staying clear of enemies and gaps along the way. Use the upgrades you unlock to help with later attempts.

pages.title: Draw Two Save Save the man
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Draw protection around a character in Draw Two Save Save the man. Look at the particular danger before shaping a shield that keeps it away from the stick figure. Let the drawing settle and see whether it protects him.

pages.title: My Mini City
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Hire construction workers in My Mini City. Build hospitals, schools, banks and other services as a village expands into a larger settlement. Improve the pace of building and keep residents happy while developing new infrastructure.

pages.title: Cargo Simulator 2023
pages.creator: KAYD Software
pages.description: Make timed deliveries in Cargo Simulator 2023. Drive one of five freight vehicles to the marked destination and bring the load in before the allowance expires. Earn points to buy another vehicle for later jobs.

pages.title: SuperKiller
pages.creator: Simplicity Games
pages.description: Find indirect attacks around guarded rooms in SuperKiller. Use a hammer's curved flight and ricochets to reach enemies behind obstacles. Break boxes or windows when they can open another route to a target.

pages.title: Triset.io
pages.creator: LapaMauve
pages.description: Capture square areas before rivals in Triset.io. Place pieces with the left mouse button, rotate them with the right and skip with space when needed. Build your territory while limiting the room available to the other players.

pages.title: Noob Vs pro 1
pages.creator: Noob vs Pro team
pages.description: Help recover stolen diamond apples in Noob Vs pro 1. Follow Noob and Pro through the story and work against Hacker's interference. Play the solo adventure or share the device for a two-player contest.

pages.title: Color Pop 3D
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Paint a circle by firing into exposed areas in Color Pop 3D. Hold the screen or space bar to shoot and release when a steel plate blocks the line. Cover every section to finish the level without hitting the barriers.

pages.title: Code Panda
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Program a route for an animal in Code Panda. Drag logic blocks into a sequence that carries the panda to the bamboo. Work through thirty-two layouts, changing the instructions when the resulting movement misses the target.

pages.title: Subway Clash 2
pages.creator: Freeway Interactive
pages.description: Lead a special-forces mission in Subway Clash 2. Fight through an old Moscow depot to stop the attackers preparing a radiation strike. Use the environment to find another angle as the enemy group defends its position.

pages.title: Endless Hands
pages.creator: SNSHUB
pages.description: Place toppings on moving pizzas in Endless Hands. Tap at the moment an ingredient can land in the required spot and watch the other hands interfering with the work. Complete the recipe before starting another preparation.

pages.title: Biozombie Outbreak
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Survive timed attacks in Biozombie Outbreak. Move through city streets, change weapons and shoot the approaching undead before they surround you. Keep the character alive until the current round's countdown finishes.

pages.title: Jewels Connect
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Clear pairs of matching stones in Jewels Connect. Each pair needs a path of at most three straight segments that does not pass through another jewel. Remove all the pieces before the timer runs out.

pages.title: Donut Shooter
pages.creator: Wanted 5 Games B.V.
pages.description: Aim treats into matching clusters in Donut Shooter. Form groups of three or more to pop them before they cross the danger line. Use each cleared opening to reach the doughnuts still hanging inside the formation.

pages.title: Pick Me Up Taxi
pages.creator: Lover3d
pages.description: Drive paying passengers in Pick Me Up Taxi. Hold to accelerate and release to brake, timing your approach to intersections to avoid a crash. Earn money from completed rides and unlock more cars as you visit new locations.

pages.title: Hidden Objects Hello Winter
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Search sixteen seasonal scenes in Hidden Objects Hello Winter. Check the list at the left and pick out the requested items in the picture. Find everything before time runs out to continue through the cozy locations.

pages.title: Cyberpunk Ninja Runner
pages.creator: Flying Sheep Studios
pages.description: Race as an enhanced parkour athlete in Cyberpunk Ninja Runner. Move from one obstacle to another, use walls and slide along lines to maintain speed. Link the movements into a faster route toward the finish.

pages.title: Let Me Out Escape
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Rearrange vehicles to free a blocked car in Let Me Out Escape. Slide other pieces into spare spaces and check which movement opens the next part of the route. Plan the order to avoid undoing the work with a dead end.

pages.title: Sift Renegade Brawl
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Join a samurai's revenge journey in Sift Renegade Brawl. Fight rival stick figures and move through the obstacles between encounters. Keep Ryu alive as the story carries him into another clash between clans.

pages.title: Euro Truck Simulator Cargo Truck Drive
pages.creator: gamefun
pages.description: Haul freight between European destinations in Euro Truck Simulator Cargo Truck Drive. Pick a truck and follow the road while managing its size through turns. Explore more routes and customize the vehicle as the transport work continues.

pages.title: Clara Wedding Planner
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help organize a ceremony in Clara Wedding Planner. Work with Clara on the arrangements for Rob and Melisa and choose details for the celebration. Complete the planning tasks so the couple's day comes together.

pages.title: King of Spider Solitaire
pages.creator: Joypad Media
pages.description: Build descending suit sequences in King of Spider Solitaire. Arrange cards from king through ace to remove a completed run. Choose a difficulty and reveal hidden cards while trying to clear the entire tableau.

pages.title: Resquack
pages.creator: Sorgard Team
pages.description: Rescue small birds from busy streets in Resquack. Guide the parent duck with WASD or the arrow keys and bring ducklings back to the lake. Watch the traffic before escorting another group across the road.

pages.title: Corona Virus Matching
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Fit block shapes into full lines in Corona Virus Matching. Clear rows or columns to remove the virus tiles and leave room for the next pieces. Complete several lines together for more points before the board runs out of space.

pages.title: Real Drift Pro
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Earn points through drifting in Real Drift Pro. Take a modified car out for a drive and hold slides to build your score. Spend the points on more vehicles, with fourteen cars available to work toward.

pages.title: Match Blast
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Clear clusters in Match Blast by clicking two or more neighboring blocks of one color. Work toward the board's target and use boosters when ordinary matches leave awkward pieces behind. Plan your removals around the goal rather than clearing colors at random.

pages.title: CraftBox Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Reassemble six pictures in CraftBox Jigsaw Puzzle. Choose an image and a difficulty setting, then fit the scattered pieces together. Use the picture details and matching edges to work your way toward the complete scene.

pages.title: Match The Stack
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Arrange piles of colored rings in Match The Stack. Swipe or tap to reposition the rings and bring matching colors together. Look over the stacks before moving a ring so your next arrangement helps organize the pieces.

pages.title: Valentine Present Coloring
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Color eight gift pictures in Valentine Present Coloring. Choose a design and apply the colors you want to its details. When your present is finished, use the camera button to download the image.

pages.title: Optical Illusion
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Explore eight visual effects in Optical Illusion. Select an illusion and start its animation, then follow the on-screen viewing prompt. The activity asks you to watch the pattern for ten seconds before looking at a wall to notice the aftereffect.

pages.title: Lizard Lady vs Herself
pages.creator: The Voices Games
pages.description: Fight manifestations of the heroine's conscience in Lizard Lady vs Herself. This first-person survival shooter takes place inside her psyche. Lock onto opponents while firing, and use jumps and dodges to keep moving through the endless confrontation.

pages.title: Ballon Paradise
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Pop the balloons while leaving red ones alone in Ballon Paradise. Click or tap valid targets as quickly as you can. Keep watching the colors as you play, since the red balloons must remain untouched.

pages.title: Knightfall
pages.creator: Indie
pages.description: Battle monsters with a knight in Knightfall. Click to attack and buy upgrades as the journey continues. Unlock additional skills and activate them with A and D to add more options to the fights.

pages.title: Christmas Story Puzzle 2
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together holiday scenes in Christmas Story Puzzle 2. Pick one of six pictures and choose a 16-, 36-, 64-, or 100-piece layout. Arrange the pieces until the complete Christmas image is restored.

pages.title: Zombies Night 2
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Defend the city during an undead attack in Zombies Night 2. Aim and shoot from a first-person view, switch between weapons, and reload before another wave closes in. Grenades give you another way to deal with approaching zombies.

pages.title: Captain of the Sea Difference
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Compare paired illustrations in Captain of the Sea Difference. Find seven changes in each scene before its one-minute timer expires. Search carefully through ten levels, checking small details as well as the larger objects.

pages.title: Angry Santa Claus
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Keep Santa flying in Angry Santa Claus. Collect gifts along the route and avoid the red devils that can hurt him. Try to extend the flight as far as possible while watching for the next obstacle.

pages.title: Laddu Champion
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Drop a swinging sweet into a basket in Laddu Champion. Release the rope at the right moment and account for obstacles along the fall. Accurate catches, quick shots, and ricochets can improve your score, while purchased magnets and springs provide help.

pages.title: World Wars 1991
pages.creator: BRAVO
pages.description: Protect your base in World Wars 1991. Drive a tank and shoot enemy forces before they destroy the position you are defending. Play alone or share one keyboard with a friend for two-player tank battles.

pages.title: Stickman Prison Escape Story 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Help a wrongly imprisoned character seek freedom in Stickman Prison Escape Story 3D. Explore the prison, run and jump through the environment, and use weapons when fighting is necessary. Mouse aiming and keyboard movement control the escape attempt.

pages.title: Woody Block Hexa Puzzle Game
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Fill the outlined board with wooden hexagonal shapes in Woody Block Hexa Puzzle Game. Move each piece into a position where it fits with the others. Collect puzzle pieces and continue to further arrangements as you progress.

pages.title: Chaos in the Desert
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Drive cartoon vehicles through a desert in Chaos in the Desert. Complete missions in the single-player mode or challenge a friend using shared keyboard controls. Each player has separate steering and action keys for the vehicle contest.

pages.title: Real Tractor Farming Simulator : Heavy Duty Tractor
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Join John as he learns farming in India in Real Tractor Farming Simulator : Heavy Duty Tractor. Take on agricultural work with farm machinery and help care for the animals. Follow the farming tasks as he learns from an experienced local family.

pages.title: The Impossible Dash
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Move a small square between sides in The Impossible Dash. Change position to slip past deadly obstacles along the route. Watch what is approaching and time each switch to keep the character from colliding with it.

pages.title: Aircraft Flying Simulator
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Take a plane over the countryside in Aircraft Flying Simulator. Manage direction and speed during the flight, then bring the aircraft down for a safe landing. Use the arrow keys to steer and the speed bar to adjust your pace.

pages.title: Fishing Guru
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Catch fish by typing in Fishing Guru. Each approaching fish carries a word, and completing it in time pulls the fish out of the water. Keep up with successive waves so the fish cannot reach your boat.

pages.title: Paradigm
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Reproduce the reference picture in Paradigm. Examine the image above the puzzle and use the mouse to arrange a matching result. Compare your work with the model as you make each change.

pages.title: Rocketate Next
pages.creator: kpded
pages.description: Rotate a maze and use a jetpack in Rocketate Next. Shift wooden boxes and planks to open a route while avoiding electrical hazards. Conserve fuel as you work through sixty levels with increasingly difficult layouts.

pages.title: Chef Slash
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Cut food into equal portions in Chef Slash. Draw slices through fruit, cheese, pizzas, cakes, and other dishes, aiming for pieces with matching sizes. Later challenges allow less time, so each cut needs both speed and accuracy.

pages.title: EG Ball Target
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Aim a ball at its target in EG Ball Target. Click or tap to send it in the right direction and earn points for successful shots. The pace increases as you continue, and a missed shot ends the attempt.

pages.title: Kiwi Adventure
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Guide a kiwi through a running and jumping adventure in Kiwi Adventure. Leap past obstacles and collect coins along the way. Keep an eye on the path ahead so the bird can clear the next hazard.

pages.title: Young Princess Laundry Day
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help sort and wash clothes in Young Princess Laundry Day. Separate white garments from colored ones, add detergent and conditioner, and start the machine. Once the wash is finished, hang the clothes outside to dry.

pages.title: Hurly Burly On The Farm
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Find hidden fruit using number clues in Hurly Burly On The Farm. Solve nonogram boards and mark completed rows and columns as you go. Earn stars across thirty puzzles to unlock farm decorations such as a barn, mill, and tractor.

pages.title: Offroad Coloring Book
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Choose one of six pictures to color in Offroad Coloring Book. Apply shades from a palette of twenty-four colors and complete the artwork. You can save the finished image or print a copy when you are done.

pages.title: EG Monkey Legend
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Run and jump through platforms in EG Monkey Legend. Collect coins, battle enemies, and spend your earnings on characters, weapons, or clothes. Ride animals such as foxes and wild pigs to travel farther through the levels.

pages.title: Beat Racer Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Steer along a neon highway in Beat Racer Online. Dodge spikes, police, and missiles while collecting orbs for new cars. Pick up special powers to destroy enemies and keep the run going for a higher score.

pages.title: Transmorpher 1
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Switch between alien forms in Transmorpher 1. Use each creature's different abilities to solve platform puzzles and navigate the level. Change characters with the number keys when another form is better suited to the route ahead.

pages.title: Money Detector: EURO
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Spot altered details on banknotes in Money Detector: EURO. Compare the two versions of each note and find seven differences. Work through five denominations, from five to one hundred euros, to collect all fifteen stars.

pages.title: Monster Go!
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Join matching creatures with energy paths in Monster Go! Cover every space on the board while connecting each pair. Routes cannot cross or overlap, so plan the entire network before closing off space needed by another color.

pages.title: Dragon Girl Creator HTML5
pages.creator: Missangest Games
pages.description: Design a half-human, half-dragon character in Dragon Girl Creator HTML5. Choose colors, horns, wings, and a tail, then add clothing and a background. Random selection buttons can suggest combinations, and you can save the finished creation.

pages.title: Candy Match
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Select matching sweets in Candy Match. Clear candies to work toward the stage's target while keeping track of the remaining moves. Choose your matches carefully so you can complete the target before the moves run out.

pages.title: Up my Wine!
pages.creator: ReCorp Games
pages.description: Jump a bottle upward in Up my Wine! Time each leap to keep climbing without falling, and collect coins along the way. Build your score and use your progress to unlock more bottles.

pages.title: Princess Punk Street Style Contest
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Give Ariel, Aurora, and Rapunzel new looks in Princess Punk Street Style Contest. Combine bold hairstyles, piercings, tattoos, bags, and clothing for the competition. Create a punk outfit for each princess before they take part.

pages.title: The Hidden Objects Game
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Help Angelina search the house in The Hidden Objects Game. Locate the missing items before her mother returns. Examine the scene carefully and work quickly enough to finish the search within the available time.

pages.title: Get10
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Combine neighboring equal numbers in Get10. Each successful match creates a tile with a higher value. Keep forming new combinations to reach ten, then continue merging if you want to push the number farther.

pages.title: Super Cricket
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Time your batting shots in Super Cricket. Hit returning balls and build the score needed to advance. Choose a quick match, a one-on-one game, or the World Cup tournament to put your batting to work.

pages.title: Battle Tank
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Destroy hostile tanks while keeping your own intact in Battle Tank. Use diamonds to purchase combat power-ups such as shields, missiles, extra bullets, and additional cannons. Choose the help you need for the next exchange of fire.

pages.title: Ouch Finger
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Steer away from hazards in Ouch Finger. Use a single touch to keep moving through the obstacles for as long as possible. Collect stars along the route to improve power-ups and work toward a higher score.

pages.title: Ice Queen Nails Spa
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Create a manicure for Elsa in Ice Queen Nails Spa. Choose a skin tone and nail polish colors, then finish the look with decorations. Experiment with different combinations across the nails to style her hands.

pages.title: Princess Halloween Ice Cream
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Decorate a seasonal dessert in Princess Halloween Ice Cream. Choose Halloween treats to finish the princess's ice cream after she prepares for the celebration. Arrange the toppings to give the dessert its own festive appearance.
